name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk locks development requirements, enforces execution boundaries, and reconciles completed work with evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Lock requirements, guard boundaries, reconcile results
interface.longDescription: AI Talk gives development tasks one consistent experience: lock observable goals, boundaries, and acceptance checks before implementation; surface only real boundary events during execution; and reconcile every modification against evidence at completion. Clear local work keeps the zero-contract Fast Path. Complex work uses RequirementContract 1.4, deterministic scope checks, stable visual binding, and explicit external-write authorization. Strict Mode remains an advanced invocation-coverage option and does not change behavior.
capabilities: Transparent pass-through for status and ordinary confirmation messages
No-contract Fast Path for clear local work
Zero reference and reporter calls on Fast Path
Deterministic contract schema and reference validation
Progressive protocol loading for complex work
Explicit excluded scope and bounded write policy
Direct or exact-proposal authorization for external writes
Stable selector and DOM fingerprint capture
Entry point and control point separation
Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
